description: Source code for c10::StorageImpl class implementation, including functions for managing storage creation, error handling, and pyobject reference counting within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: StorageImpl
classes.description: Implementation of storage management, including data pointer access, reference counting, and creation helpers.

methods.name: throwNullDataPtrError
methods.description: Raises an error when attempting to access a null data pointer in a tensor.

methods.name: warnDeprecatedDataPtr
methods.description: Issues a warning about deprecated FakeTensor.data_ptr usage.

methods.name: StorageImpl::throw_data_ptr_access_error
methods.description: Throws an error if data pointer access is invalid.

methods.name: StorageImpl::incref_pyobject
methods.description: Increments reference count of associated PyObject.

methods.name: StorageImpl::decref_pyobject
methods.description: Decrements reference count of associated PyObject.

methods.name: StorageImpl::try_incref_pyobject
methods.description: Attempts to increment reference count of PyObject, returns success status.

methods.name: SetStorageImplCreate
methods.description: Registers a custom storage implementation creation function for a device type.

methods.name: GetStorageImplCreate
methods.description: Retrieves the registered storage implementation creation function for a device type.

methods.name: make_storage_impl
methods.description: Creates a StorageImpl object, possibly using a custom constructor based on device type.
